scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I'm calling to check the status of my housing loan application. Can you tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, I'd like to know the details of my loan terms if it has been approved.
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. The loan amount is $425,000 with a term of 360 months. The interest rate is 6.875%. The loan is a conventional first lien for a home purchase. The total loan costs are $10,761.60, and the estimated property value is $445,000. The debt-to-income ratio is 44%. This is not a high-cost mortgage, and there is no negative amortization.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. I'm glad to hear that my application was approved. Can you tell me if the loan has been sold to another institution? Also, I noticed the debt-to-income ratio is 44%. What does this mean for my loan?
dialogue.agent: The loan has not been sold to another institution. The debt-to-income ratio is the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying your debts, including this loan. A ratio of 44% means that 44% of your monthly income is allocated to debt payments.

dialogue.user: I see. Is there any specific reason why my debt-to-income ratio is at 44%? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include underwriting rationale, so I cannot provide the specific reason for your debt-to-income ratio. You were approved for a conventional first lien loan.

dialogue.user: Got it. I understand that the specific reason for the debt-to-income ratio isn't available. Just one more thing, are there any prepayment penalties or balloon payment terms associated with this loan?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include information about prepayment penalties or balloon payment terms.

dialogue.user: Understood. Thank you for the information. I appreciate your help. <Neutral> The conversation was informative, but I wish I could have gotten more details about the debt-to-income ratio and other loan terms.
